sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive sectors dominate market leadership with Consumer Defensive and Healthcare posting all-green profiles and top momentum scores, while Communication Services and Technology severely lag.

Leadership remains tightly concentrated in low-beta, defensive areas of the market. Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.917) and Healthcare (momentum 0.833) are the sole sectors exhibiting positive returns across all timeframes, with Consumer Defensive maintaining top-3 rank consistency across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows. 

Rotation beneath the surface is narrow. Basic Materials showed short-term improvement by advancing 2 spots, while Financial and Utilities each slipped 1 spot over the last five sessions. Growth and cyclicals remain largely out of favor, anchored by persistent momentum weakness in Communication Services (0.167) and Technology (0.250).

## Strength
- Market breadth is highly restricted, with only 2 of 11 sectors qualifying as all-green across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD horizons.
- Consumer Defensive stands out as the single sustained leader, holding top-3 rank status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes with a sector-high momentum score of 0.917 (rank 2 YTD).
- Healthcare reinforces defensive strength as the second all-green sector, carrying a 0.833 momentum score and ranking 3 YTD.

## Movers & Momentum
- Momentum leaders are led by Consumer Defensive (0.917), Healthcare (0.833), Real Estate (0.600, rank 5 YTD), and Energy (0.567, rank 1 YTD).
- Basic Materials posted the largest 5-day rank improvement, rising +2 spots to rank 7 with a 0.417 momentum score.
- Financial and Utilities were the primary decliners over the past 5 sessions, each dropping -1 spot to ranks 8 (momentum 0.500) and 9 (momentum 0.417), respectively.
- Momentum laggards are anchored by Communication Services at 0.167 (rank 11 YTD) and Technology at 0.250 (rank 4 YTD).

## Divergences
- Energy maintains the #1 YTD rank, but its absolute momentum score of 0.567 trails well behind Consumer Defensive (0.917) and Healthcare (0.833).
- Technology exhibits a steep internal rank-to-momentum disconnect, holding a high YTD rank of 4 despite a lagging momentum score of 0.250.
- No early-warning fragile all-green divergences were detected among the leading sectors.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Housing-linked cyclicals, consumer staples, and healthcare are demonstrating leadership and sharp momentum gains, while tech hardware, semiconductors, and power-related plays continue to fade.

Market breadth reflects 42 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all measured timeframes. Leadership remains anchored in defensive and consumer pockets such as Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances, Discount Stores, and Medical Distribution, with housing-related groups like Residential Construction and Lumber & Wood Production staging notable short-term rank surges. 

Conversely, tech hardware and semiconductor spaces are actively rolling over. Electronic Components, Semiconductors, and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials all experienced heavy five-day rank declines alongside depressed momentum scores. Additionally, energy transition and power plays remain pinned at the bottom of relative performance.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 42 of 144 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods, led by Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.91), Discount Stores (momentum 0.88), and Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.84).
- **Healthcare & Regulated Defensives:** Utilities - Regulated Water (momentum 0.81), Medical Distribution (momentum 0.81), Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.81), and Medical Care Facilities (momentum 0.80) all maintain all-green profiles.
- **Sustained Leaders:** Groups consistently holding top-36 positions across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include Household & Personal Products, Lodging, Insurance Brokers, and Discount Stores.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Housing and Retail Surges:** Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances led all gainers, jumping 20 spots to rank 25 (momentum 0.91). Additional strong weekly movers include Packaging & Containers (+17 to rank 62), Residential Construction (+17 to rank 86), Department Stores (+16 to rank 66), and Home Improvement Retail (+14 to rank 82).
- **Tech & Semiconductor Slide:** Severe 5-day rank declines hit Electronic Components (-20 spots to rank 72, momentum 0.22), Semiconductors (-16 spots to rank 75, momentum 0.20), Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (-12 spots to rank 26, momentum 0.31), and Software - Infrastructure (-12 spots to rank 81, momentum 0.34).
- **Persistent Bottom Laggards:** Solar anchors the absolute low for momentum at 0.038 (rank 143), followed by Utilities - Independent Power Producers (0.103, rank 139), Uranium (0.115, rank 141), Aluminum (0.148, rank 133), and Capital Markets (0.148, rank 121).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Specialty Retail (momentum 0.60) dropped 9 spots in 5 days, while Insurance - Diversified (momentum 0.71) slid 6 spots. Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.61, -4 spots) and Medical Distribution (momentum 0.81, -3 spots) also showed early relative rank slippage despite high baseline momentum.
- **Emerging Materials:** Metals are demonstrating early stage recovery off low baselines, evidenced by 5-day rank jumps in Gold (+12 spots, momentum 0.40), Silver (+8 spots, momentum 0.34), and Copper (+7 spots, momentum 0.35). 
- **Industrial Rotation:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery jumped 10 spots over 5 sessions, yet its momentum score remains low at 0.40.
